item.title: PAGASA Daily Weather - 4:00 PM, 24 September 2026
item.description:

[FORECAST WEATHER CONDITIONS]
1. PLACE: Mindanao, Negros Island Region, Aklan, Iloilo, Guimaras, and Siquijor
